prompt: Who needs to sign up for a visit?

options.text: Everyone whose window faces the courtyard
options.zh: 所有窗戶朝中庭的住戶
options.whyZh: 中庭側窗戶可直接清潔，不必登記陽台清潔。

options.text: Anyone who will be away on both days
options.whyZh: 需要登記與否看窗戶是否朝私人陽台，不是看這兩天是否在家。

options.text: Residents who want a window facing their private balcony cleaned
options.zh: 想清潔朝私人陽台窗戶的住戶
options.whyZh: 公告說這側窗戶只有登記陽台清潔才能清洗。

options.text: Residents who keep a spare key at the office
options.zh: 把備用鑰匙留在辦公室的住戶
options.whyZh: 留鑰匙不構成登記條件，工作人員也不能用那把鑰匙。

explanationZh: 公告說這側窗戶只有登記陽台清潔才能清洗。
evidence: If your window opens onto a private balcony, however, the crew can clean that side only if you sign up for a balcony visit.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: If your window opens onto a private balcony, however, the crew can clean that side only if you sign up for a balcony visit.

vocabulary.note: 此處特指要讓人員進入住戶陽台的服務。
